The '''2026–27 Maltese Premier League''' (referred to as the '''VBet Malta Premier''' for sponsorship reasons)<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.facebook.com/reel/1226543259574365/ |title= League Title Sponsor Announcement - VBET Malta Premier Season 2026-27|language=en |access-date=2026-09-07 |via=www.facebook.com}}</ref> is the 112th season of top-flight league [[Association football|football]] in [[Malta]]. The season began on 17 August 2026. [[Floriana F.C.|Floriana]] entered the season as the defending champions having won their 27th Premier League title in the previous season.

== Teams ==
Twelve teams are competing in the league: the top ten teams from the [[2024–25 Maltese Premier League|previous season]] and two teams promoted from the [[2024–25 Maltese Challenge League|Challenge League]].

=== Changes from the previous season ===
; Promoted to the Premier League
* [[Birżebbuġa St. Peter's F.C.|Birzebbuga]]
* [[Balzan F.C.|Balzan]]
; Relegated to the [[2026–27 Maltese Challenge League|Challenge League]]
* [[Naxxar Lions F.C.|Naxxar Lions]]
* [[Tarxien Rainbows F.C.|Tarxien Rainbows]]

== Format ==
In the current format (since the 2024–25 season) the Maltese Premier League will be made up of 12 teams and be split into an Opening Round and Closing Round.<ref name=format>{{#invoke:cite|web|last=Galea |first=Albert |date=24 April 2024 |title=New Premier League explained: 'New format will not be damnation or salvation of Maltese football |url=https://www.independent.com.mt/articles/2024-04-24/local-news/New-Premier-League-explained-New-format-will-not-be-damnation-or-salvation-of-Maltese-football-6736260505 |website=Malta Independent}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|last=Camilleri |first=Valhmor |date=2023-04-13 |title=Number of Premier League teams down to 12 from 2024-25 |url=https://sport.timesofmalta.com/2023/04/13/number-of-premier-league-teams-down-to-12-from-2024-25/ |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=SportsDesk |language=en-US}}</ref> In the Opening Round each of the 12 teams play each other once before the league is then split into a Top 6 and a Bottom 6, each team  playing the neams in their split a further time.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|title=Draws held for 2025/26 BOV National Leagues|url=https://www.mfa.com.mt/news/competitions/202526-bov-national-leagues-draws/|date=18 July 2025|website=MFA.com.mt |language=en}}</ref>
Points are reset and not carried forward to the Closing Round.

The league champions and the teams for UEFA competitions are determined as follow:<ref name=format/>
*If both the Opening Round and the Closing Round are won by the same team:
**The winners of the Opening and the Closing Rounds are declared the league champions and qualify for the UEFA Champions League;
**Second placed teams in the Opening Round and the Closing Round qualify for the UEFA Conference League;
**If the same team finishes second in both the Opening and the Closing Rounds, a playoff match between third placed teams in the Opening Round and the Closing Round is played for the remaining spot in the UEFA Conference League;
*If the champions of the Opening Round are placed second in the Closing Round, and the champions of the Closing Round are placed second in the Opening Round:
**A playoff match between the champions of the Opening and the Closing Round is played to determine the league champions;
**A playoff match between third placed teams in the Opening Round and the Closing Round is played for the remaining spot in the UEFA Conference League;
*Otherwise, a Final Four tournament between winners and runners-up of the Opening and the Closing Rounds is played (if the same team finishes second in both the Opening and the Closing Rounds, the third placed team with the best aggregate points is included in the Final Four tournament), with the teams seeded based on the aggregate points.
